personality_one_liner: Elegante marittimo: a premium, dark, and cinematic experience evoking the depths of the sea with dusty blue and warm sand accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for luxury feel. Intentional padding. Use flex grids effectively, no accidental empty spaces.

do's: Sticky category chip row in Menu

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A cinematic landing screen focusing on the restaurant's elegant maritime brand, current status, and primary actions.

states.error: Error loading status with a retry button in brandPrimary

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image (`images.home_hero`) with a strong top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to >80% surface at the bottom). Centered restaurant logo (using `images.logo`), elegant display typography for tagline 'Trattoria del Mare'. Below, an elegant status indicator ('Aperto' or 'Chiuso' with hours). Bottom 1/3 contains primary CTAs: 'Chiama' (gold/sand) and 'Menu' (dusty blue/glass). Elegant, sparse layout where the dark ocean visual carries the mood.

screens.name: Menu
screens.purpose: A refined, text-only digital menu categorized clearly with a sticky header.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for menu categories and items.
states.empty: No menu items available right now.

screens.layout: Top: Sticky `ScrollView` (horizontal) for categories (Aperitivi, Bevande, Antipasti, Primi, Frittura, Secondi di pesce, La Nostra Griglia, Le Carni, Pizze) wrapped in a frosted glass container. The active chip uses `brandPrimary` (gold/sand) with `onBrandPrimary` text; inactive chips are subtle outlines or `surfaceTertiary`. Below: Sectioned `SectionList` or `FlatList` with large Serif headers for categories. Menu items are text-only: Left side has Dish Name (Serif, `lg` or `xl`, white) and description (if any, Sans, `muted`, `sm`), plus a subtle small pill or number for allergens. Right side has Price (`brandPrimary` gold/sand color, Serif). Use dividers (`1A2639`) between items. An 'Allergen Legend' FAB or sticky footer at the bottom.

screens.name: Info
screens.purpose: Contact details, map, hours, and allergen legend in an elegant structured layout.
screens.layout: Top banner image of Imperia coastal scene (`images.info_banner`) with gradient scrim. Below, sections styled as subtle glass or `surfaceSecondary` cards: 1. Contact (Address: Borgo Prino, Imperia, Phone: 0183 754557). Include 'Apri in Maps' button and 'Chiama' button. 2. Hours Table (Every day except Wed, 12:00-14:30 and 19:00-22:30). 3. Allergen Legend (List of numbers corresponding to allergens). Use generous padding, serif section titles, and clean sans-serif data points.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality layout: Cinematic, minimal, spacious, and reliant on depth and texture over pure flatness.

Do NOT use any blues besides the dusty blue specified (`brand`, `brandSecondary`, `brandTertiary`, `borderStrong`). Avoid default navy, indigo, or purple. The theme relies on very dark blue-grey for surfaces.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern perfectly on `Home` and `Info` screens: `transparent` -> `surface` over the image to ensure text readability.
Use `Cormorant Garamond` for all headings, menu item names, and large display text. Use `DM Sans` ONLY for prices, buttons, labels, and descriptions.

Ensure the menu is TEXT-ONLY. Do not add placeholder images for menu items. Use the layout: Dish name left, price right, separated by subtle space or dotted leader if necessary. Price color must be the `brandPrimary` gold/sand.
The horizontal category chips in the Menu screen must be sticky at the top, wrapped in a frosted glass container (`expo-blur`). Active chip is gold/sand, inactive is subtle.
Provide Haptics: add subtle vibration on tab presses, category chip selections, and CTA buttons.
Address action 'Apri in Maps' must open maps with Imperia, Borgo Prino coordinates. Call action must dial '0183 754557'.

Since the logo already has a black/dark background, render it with `contentFit="contain"` on the Home screen over the dark wave background. Use the scrim to blend its dark background into the app's `surface` color.
No emojis allowed anywhere in the UI. Use `Feather` icons.
